title: Repossession Expenses and Personal Property — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
**Recovery & Remarketing policy — repossession expenses on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

1. *No longer in force:* "A repossession expense can be charged only while the contract status is assigned for repossession or repossessed." This clause is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current recovery charge terms.
2. The agency fee is the involuntary repossession agency fee for an involuntary recovery and the voluntary agency fee for a voluntary surrender. *No longer in force:* "a transport fee of the transport fee for the tier applies only to an involuntary recovery" — this part of the clause has been superseded by the current recovery charge terms. A condition report fee of the condition report fee for the tier is charged once per repossession.
3. *No longer in force:* "Storage is charged at the daily storage fee for each day the vehicle is stored beyond the free days, counting from the repossession date to the release or sale date, and is billed when the vehicle leaves the lot." This clause has been superseded by the current storage terms.
4. Personal property found in the vehicle is inventoried and held free of charge; the customer may collect it in person or have it shipped at the carrier's cost.
5. Personal property may be disposed of only after the personal property hold days have fully elapsed from the date the vehicle was repossessed. The hold is counted in calendar days starting the day after the repossession date; disposal is permitted from the calendar day after the repossession date plus the hold days. The clock starts from the repossession date recorded on the contract.
6. Expenses are booked to fees due and become part of any reinstatement, redemption or deficiency amount.

The agency fee, the condition report fee and the personal property hold remain in force with the figures of the tier.

### Personal property hold boundary (15-day hold)

| Day counted from the repossession date | Disposal permitted? |
|---|---|
| The repossession date itself | No |
| The 15th calendar day after the repossession date (the hold's last day) | No — the hold has not fully elapsed |
| The 16th calendar day after the repossession date | Yes — the first day disposal is permitted |

### Agency fee by recovery type

| How the vehicle came back | Agency fee |
|---|---|
| Involuntary recovery | the involuntary repossession agency fee |
| Voluntary surrender | the voluntary agency fee |

superseded_clauses: A repossession expense can be charged only while the contract status is repo_assigned or repossessed.
a transport fee of repo_transport_fee applies only to an involuntary recovery

Storage is charged at storage_daily_fee for each day the vehicle is stored beyond storage_free_days, counting from repossession_date to the release or sale date, and is billed when the vehicle leaves the lot.
